mostWorthwhile.text: Creating the mineral-rich sea brought the geological sequence together: plate movement made a continent, rainfall weathered it, and rivers carried material to the sea.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two failed weathering guesses and subsequent empty inspections were repetitive. It was especially confusing that rivers could not combine with the crust but could combine with weathered rock later.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the hydrothermal vent had no available partners, even though its description said it carried dissolved chemicals into seawater.

arbitrary.text: Using fire on the crust to make moving plates felt like a compressed symbolic gesture rather than a clear physical recipe, though the result usefully qualified how plate motion works.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the vent's chemical energy and the mineral-rich sea contribute to a living world, especially when the explanations distinguish mythic gestures from physical processes.
